correctness.rationale: The rank-r complete FO type of distinguished constants and chosen tuple has its full equality/successor atomic diagram and SET (not multiset) of possible rank-(r-1) one-point extension types. A selected-vertex cyclic-order encoding with positive gaps is bijective with these diagrams. Splitting a gap g inserts one new element, matching every possible quantifier witness; repetitions are separate block choices. Gap truncation at B_r=2^(r+1) is valid inductively: if two gaps >=2 B_(r-1), any split either leaves one side <B_(r-1), which can be matched exactly while other stays large, or leaves two large sides, which can be matched; smaller gaps agree exactly. Thus all infinite cycles reduce to 32x32 canonical gap pairs at rank4. Independently reimplemented gap partition and complete recursive types, obtaining class counts 4,14,40,108,340 at ranks 0..4 and sharp minimal representative sizes 4,7,11,19,35; the only rank4 maximally large representative was (17,18). No extrapolation from small graph experiments: exhaustive finite table follows the proven quantifier-rank cutoff. Source verify_symbolic.py and verify_direct.py were inspected for exact diagram, reuse/splits, and independent direct recursion.
